parts.notes: Frame: x=0 at the body end nearest the shaft, y across (0 to 11.8), z up from body bottom. Body 22.2 x 11.8 (drawing; MCAD uses 22.5). Case height 22.7 without spline (MCAD only). Tab holes d2.0 at x=-2.3 and 24.8 (spacing 27.1), y=5.9, each with an outward slot about 1.3 wide (MCAD only; drawing does not dimension holes).
